title: Exact localization of the normalized native inverse-image square
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, schemes X,Y, a morphism f:X→Y and an integer n≥0. Use the system derived categories and normalized finite evaluations of [def-sf-integral-system-operations, def-weil-compact-support-native-system-evaluation]. Let r be an ordinary direct-image isomorphism whose finite evaluation square is the normalized direct section square, as specified in [lem-sf-integral-native-ordinary-comparison]. Then evaluation of the exact localization of its ordinary left-adjoint uniqueness isomorphism, followed by native evalG, agrees with pullbackTensorDerivedEvaluation followed by the localized inverse of nativeFinitePullIso, on every derived system M on Y. The comparison maps are the explicit ordinary constructions of [lem-sf-integral-native-ordinary-comparison], not arbitrary witnesses. No boundedness or faithfulness of evaluations is assumed.

source.place: Coefficient comparisons preserve evaluation and adjunction units/counits; primitive whole-system operation comparison in Step 1 of lem-sf-integral-support-strict-tower-comparison. Stacks 03DI, 0941, 0D6E; Zheng Construction 4.1 and Lemma 4.10.

proof.text: Apply localization natural-transformation extensionality to show that exact localization preserves a commuting square of isomorphisms. Cancel the comparison factors, use exactSquare_fac and mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_fac, then check each complex degree using the given ordinary square.

Identify the exact localization of ordinaryEvaluation with pullbackTensorDerivedEvaluation by its full cochain normalization. Its termwise formula is the inverse sequence comparison followed by the intrinsic finite-level comparison.

Apply the exact-square transport calculation to the ordinary native comparison. Replace the localized ordinary evaluation by the normalized derived one and localize the finite inverse coordinate change. This gives the displayed derived pullback evaluation equality for every derived input.

theorem derived_pull_square {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ)
    (r : pullbackTensorSequenceDirect l E f ≅
      ProEtale.VaryingRing.push (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
        (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) f)
    (hr : ∀ N, (coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).map (r.hom.app N) ≫
      (compactSupportOrdinaryDirectEvaluation l E f n).hom.app N =
        (pullbackTensorSequenceDirectEvaluation l E f n).hom.app N)
    (M : System l E Y) :
    letI := ProEtale.StrictTower.modulePullback_additive (compactSupportSystemLevel l E n) f
    letI := ProEtale.StrictTower.modulePullback_finiteLimits (compactSupportSystemLevel l E n) f
    letI := ProEtale.StrictTower.modulePullback_finiteColimits (compactSupportSystemLevel l E n) f
    letI := sfIntrinsicPullback_additive (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f
    letI := sfIntrinsicPullback_preservesFiniteLimits (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f
    letI := sfIntrinsicPullback_preservesFiniteColimits (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f
    (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E X n).map
        ((derivedPullIso l E f r).hom.app M) ≫
      (ProEtale.VaryingRing.evalG (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
        (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) f n).hom.app M =
    (pullbackTensorDerivedEvaluation l E f n).hom.app M ≫
      (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso (nativeFinitePullIso l E f n)).inv.app
        ((coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E Y n).obj M)
